blocks.tamil_translation: thing at all with Him, that He does not punish him; this is the right the servants have from Allah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ لَقِيَ اللهَ لَايُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً، وَلَايَقْتُلُ نَفْساً لَقِيَ اللهَ وَهُوَ خَفِيفُ الظَّهْرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير وفي اسناده ابن لهيعة، مجمع الزوائد:١٦٧/١
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ibn Abbas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever meets Allah in a state of not having associated anything at all with Allah and not having killed anyone (against the Deen), he will meet Allah lightly burdened (since he does not carry the load of these two sins)!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَرِيرٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ مَاتَ لَايُشْرِكُ بِاللهِ شَيْئاً وَلَمْ يَتَنَدَّ بِدَمٍ حَرَامٍ أُدْخِلَ مِنْ أَيِّ أَبْوَابِ الْجَنَّةِ شَاءَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير ورجاله موثقون، مجمع الزوائد:١ /١٦٥
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jarir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever dies in a state of not having associated anything at all with Allah and not having shed anyone's blood (by killing) in a way forbidden by the Deen, will be entered through whichever of the gates of Jannah he wishes.”

blocks.text: To have Iman in Allah and in all the unseen matters (that the Deen tells of); to firmly accept every message of Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ on the basis of trust in him; and to give up the perishing pleasures, the sights seen with the eyes, and all worldly experiences that run contrary to his word.
